description: This file defines the AmqpContext class, which encapsulates context information used by the AMQP Adapter in the Eclipse Hono project. It manages message details, such as payload, address, device, and delivery state, facilitating message processing within the adapter.

classes.name: AmqpContext
classes.description: A class that contains context information used by the AMQP Adapter when uploading messages to Hono. It manages message details, device authentication, delivery state, and metrics timing, facilitating message processing within the adapter.

methods.name: fromMessage
methods.description: Creates an AmqpContext instance using the specified delivery, message, and authenticated device. It initializes context fields based on the message properties and address.

methods.name: getMessagePayload
methods.description: Returns the body/payload of the AMQP message as a Buffer object.

methods.name: getPayloadSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the message payload in bytes.

methods.name: getMessageContentType
methods.description: Retrieves the content type of the AMQP message.

methods.name: delivery
methods.description: Returns the ProtonDelivery object associated with this context.

methods.name: getEndpoint
methods.description: Returns the target endpoint type for this message.

methods.name: getAddress
methods.description: Returns the resource identifier representing the message address.

methods.name: getAuthenticatedDevice
methods.description: Returns the device object that has been authenticated for this message, or null if unauthenticated.

methods.name: isDeviceAuthenticated
methods.description: Checks if the device is authenticated.

methods.name: isRemotelySettled
methods.description: Checks if the message delivery was settled remotely by the device.

methods.name: setTimer
methods.description: Assigns a Timer.Sample object to measure processing duration.

methods.name: getTimer
methods.description: Retrieves the Timer.Sample used for measuring processing time.

methods.name: getTraceSamplingPriority
methods.description: Gets the current sampling priority for distributed tracing spans.

methods.name: setTraceSamplingPriority
methods.description: Sets the sampling priority for distributed tracing spans.
